appDescription: A car app that leaves short voice messages at places on the road for yourself, friends and family to hear when they drive by later.

function.name: START_CAPSULE_RECORDING
function.description: Start recording a voice capsule at the current location right away.

function.name: SAVE_CAPSULE_RECORDING
function.description: Finish the voice capsule being recorded and save it.

function.name: CANCEL_CAPSULE_RECORDING
function.description: Stop the voice capsule being recorded and discard it.
